path.observation: metrics:baseline shows 4/5 chemical-invalid attempts, structure_pass 0, bond recovery 0.0, strain 647.2; condition_library shows C4/C5/C6 each atom-hit 1/1 while C2 has 2/4 atom hits and 0/3 bond hits.
path.change: Stage reliable singleton anchors first, add bond-rich C2 with anchors, briefly pulse unreliable C1/C3, then release C1/C3 while retaining C2 and anchors.
path.hypothesis: Anchoring before C2 and limiting C1/C3 exposure may reduce early clash/strain and allow selected C2 bonds to form; this is a testable schedule, not a claimed improvement.

path.observation: metrics:baseline reports C2 atom hits 2/4 but bond hits 0/3 under full 100-step exposure, with 4/5 chemical-invalid attempts and high strain.
path.change: Seed C2 alone to expose selected bond constraints, relax with reliable anchors, re-enter C2 with anchors, release C2 briefly for C1/C3, then finish with the full condition set.
path.hypothesis: Isolating C2 early and using staged release/re-entry may reduce persistent strain and give explicit C2 bonds an independent formation window; testable only.

path.observation: metrics:bond_seed_relax shows C2 atom recovery perfect (8/8 atom hits) but C2 bond hits 0/6, with structure_pass 2/2 and strain mean 212.3; metrics:baseline shows full-set C1/C3 exposure gave 4/5 chemical-invalid attempts and 0 bond recovery.
path.change: Keep C2 continuously active from 0-100, lengthen the initial C2-only window to 40 steps, add C4 at 40-60, add C5/C6 at 60-80, and introduce unreliable C1/C3 only in the final 20 steps.
path.hypothesis: Continuous C2 exposure plus delayed C1/C3 may give the selected C2 bonds an uninterrupted formation window while preserving anchor relaxation and final atom recovery; testable only, not claimed as an improvement.

path.observation: metrics:staged_anchors (anchor-first with a brief full-set pulse) had structure_pass 0 but one C2 bond hit, while metrics:bond_seed_relax had structure_pass 2/2 but C2 bond hits 0/6 under a C2-first schedule; metrics:bond_seed_relax also shows C4 2/2, C5 1/2, C6 1/2 atom hits.
path.change: Start with C4/C5/C6 anchor relaxation, add C2 with C4, expand to C5/C6, then isolate C2 alone for 20 steps as a late bond window before the final full set.
path.hypothesis: Anchor-first preconditioning followed by a late C2-only window may improve selected C2 bond formation relative to the early C2-first schedule in metrics:bond_seed_relax; testable only and complementary to the continuous-C2 variant.

path.observation: Baseline held C1-C4 active for all 100 updates and produced 5/5 chemical_invalid with zero atom/bond/recovery and J=0.0 (metrics:baseline); no historical best is available. condition_library shows C1 is the aromatic ring fragment and C2-C4 are single oxygen conditions.
path.change: Seed the C1 ring first, then introduce one oxygen condition at a time in separate 20-step windows, and release all conditions for the final 20 updates.
path.hypothesis: Test whether reducing simultaneous C2-C4 exposure while letting the C1 ring scaffold guide staged oxygen placement avoids early overconstraint and permits a chemically valid final repair.

path.observation: Baseline's fully simultaneous C1-C4 schedule was chemically invalid in 5/5 attempts with no recovery (metrics:baseline). condition_library separates C1 from the three individual oxygen conditions, enabling an order-reversed test.
path.change: Start with an unconstrained 10-step window, place C2, C3, and C4 sequentially first, then activate the C1 ring late, and finish with a 10-step unconstrained release window.
path.hypothesis: Test whether oxygen-first anchoring followed by late ring closure and final release can resolve the chemical invalidity seen under simultaneous baseline constraints, providing a complementary ordering test to ring-first staging.

path.observation: metrics:ring_first_staggered_oxygens has J=0.833, structure_pass 2/2, and atom/bond recovery 0.833, but C4 atom_hits are 0/2; metrics:oxygen_first_ring_late is chemical_invalid 1/2 with bond_lengths/bond_angles failures, so C1-first ordering is retained.
path.change: Preserve the C1 ring-first staged oxygen sequence, release at 80-90, then re-enter C4 on the grid window 90-100 so C4 receives a late post-release exposure without using non-grid boundaries.
path.hypothesis: Test whether a late C4 re-entry after C1 scaffold release can engage the currently missed C4 oxygen without simultaneous oxygen overconstraint, while retaining the C1-first ordering from the historical best.

path.observation: metrics:ring_first_staggered_oxygens reports C4 atom_hits 0/2 while overall J=0.833 and C1/C2/C3 have nonzero hits; C4 was the last oxygen window in that historical best.
path.change: Keep the same grid-aligned 20-step exposure counts and final 20-step empty release as the historical best, but rotate oxygen order to C4 first, then C2, then C3 after the C1 seed.
path.hypothesis: Test whether introducing C4 immediately after C1 scaffold seeding changes C4 engagement relative to placing C4 last, isolating oxygen ordering from total exposure.
